sources.scope: Eq6 known only gamma>=1; Question1 exactly asks target gamma<1, sigma>d/2 and all complex V with algebraic multiplicities.
Radial V, q between(d+1)/2 and d, a power q/p<1 outside the eigenvalue sum. Does not supply target linear integral homogeneity for arbitrary complex potentials.
Still lists Cuenin–Frank open-problem manuscript; no resolution indicated. Routing only, not certification.

registry_checks: Cuenin/complex-potentials/subunit/Lieb–Thirring metadata scanned in Palomar/Hexagon/OpenAI/Colbrook. OpenAI262 concerns real 1D sharp Lieb–Thirring constants, not these nonselfadjoint moments.
scope_comparison: Endpoint sigma=d/2 counterexamples do not refute strict sigma>d/2. Gamma>=1 bounds, radial restrictions, and nonlinear powers of the integral fail the requested subunit gamma universal estimate.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement; retain Open.
